# Change Warming Runtime
1. Update boundary contracts in `schemas/warming.py` — settings fields live in its `_warming_settings.py` sibling and are re-exported, so import stays `from schemas.warming import …`.
2. Put logic in the owning board/settings, pacing/fleet, cycle, transition/loop or runtime module.
3. Persist through the warming repository; keep timing injectable through `services/warming/_seams.py`.
4. Classify/log failures so tasks cannot die silently.
5. Test normal behavior, persistence/restart, failure and cancellation. Keep task ownership until terminal, fence every Telegram dispatch with the runtime generation, and book attempts immediately before dispatch so unknown outcomes remain spent.
6. Run relevant backend gates.

Verify: no API/UI policy in warming; Telegram uses typed actions; task stop/reconcile is bounded; restart/promotion/handoff/delete cannot cross a non-quiescent task; board/read paths stay bulk-loaded. Runtime invariants live in `context/runtime-warming.md`.
